about_the_game:
This game is a wave-based real-time strategy experience with a roguelike structure, focused on macro-level decision making rather than constant micromanagement.

You will face relentless enemy waves in a dark fantasy world filled with magic, monsters, and war without glory. Every choice matters — poor decisions will end your run, often sooner than you expect.

Victory is possible, but it must be earned through learning, adaptation, and multiple runs.

Core Gameplay

  • Real-Time Strategy (RTS) focused on high-level strategic decisions

  • Wave-based enemy progression with increasing pressure

  • Permanent death: when you lose, the run is over

  • Roguelike structure: each run forces you to adapt to new conditions

Short-Term vs Long-Term Strategy

Every run forces you to choose between immediate survival and long-term dominance.

There are no universal strategies. Each decision shifts the balance between risk and reward.

To win, you must constantly evaluate when to defend, when to invest, and when to commit fully, knowing that some mistakes cannot be undone

Important Notes

  • You control your units in real time, issuing orders and reacting to the battlefield

  • The focus is on macro-level strategy, not fast APM or constant micromanagement

  • Designed for players who enjoy thinking under pressure and accepting consequences
